key: Heyo, this is Magma Gang property. Best be tailin' off.
en: Heyo, this is Magma Gang property. Best be tailin' off.
ja: よお、ここはマグマ団の縄張りだぜ。とっとと消えな。

key: Yo, make like a babe and head out. Magma Gang only past here.
en: Yo, make like a babe and head out. Magma Gang only past here.
ja: よお、いい子だからここは通り過ぎな。この先はマグマ団専用だ。

key: You want in, you gotta join our little family.
en: You want in, you gotta join our little family.
ja: 入りたいなら、俺たちのファミリーに加わるしかないぜ。

key: You interested?
en: You interested?
ja: 興味あるか?

key: Yeah! That's what I'm talkin' 'bout! But it ain't that easy.
en: Yeah! That's what I'm talkin' 'bout! But it ain't that easy.
ja: よっしゃ! そう来なくちゃな! だが、そう簡単にはいかねえぜ。

key: You want in, you gotta prove yourself. You gotta beat us to prove your worth. Got it? Good!
en: You want in, you gotta prove yourself. You gotta beat us to prove your worth. Got it? Good!
ja: 入りたきゃ、実力を証明しな。俺たちを倒して価値を示すんだ。わかったか? よし!

key: Whaddya know...
en: Whaddya know...
ja: なんてこった……

key: ...Huh. All right, you in.
en: ...Huh. All right, you in.
ja: ……へえ。よし、お前は合格だ。

key: NIHIL: Well, you got bite. Here's your golden ticket to the Magma Gang.
en: NIHIL: Well, you got bite. Here's your golden ticket to the Magma Gang.
ja: ニヒル: へえ、やるじゃねえか。マグマ団への黄金チケットをやるよ。

key: KRIZ: We have tickets now?
en: KRIZ: We have tickets now?
ja: クリズ: え、チケットなんてあったのか?

key: NIHIL: Yes, we have tickets now. Here's yours: "Admit One to Sarcasmville."
en: NIHIL: Yes, we have tickets now. Here's yours: "Admit One to Sarcasmville."
ja: ニヒル: ああ、今はあるんだよ。お前のはこれだ。「皮肉タウン、一名様ご入場」

key: Good for you only, Kriz. Expires never.
en: Good for you only, Kriz. Expires never.
ja: お前限定だぜ、クリズ。有効期限はなし。

key: Look, just scoot so the new guy can meet the boss.
en: Look, just scoot so the new guy can meet the boss.
ja: いいから、どけよ。新入りをボスに会わせるんだから。

key: KRIZ: Yeah, sure.
en: KRIZ: Yeah, sure.
ja: クリズ: ああ、わかったよ。

key: Where is Sarcasmville? Is it in the Orre Region?
en: Where is Sarcasmville? Is it in the Orre Region?
ja: 皮肉タウンってどこにあるんだ? オーレ地方か?

key: NIHIL: I quit.
en: NIHIL: I quit.
ja: ニヒル: もう知らん。

key: Then scram!
en: Then scram!
ja: さっさと消えろ!

key: Heyo, this is Magma Gang property. Best be tailin' off, Aqua fool.
en: Heyo, this is Magma Gang property. Best be tailin' off, Aqua fool.
ja: よお、ここはマグマ団の縄張りだぜ。とっとと消えな、アクアの間抜けが。

key: KRIZ: Hey, shouldn't you be heading out for the operation?
en: KRIZ: Hey, shouldn't you be heading out for the operation?
ja: クリズ: おい、作戦に出発しなくていいのか?

key: You're not gonna move? Then we'll make you move!
en: You're not gonna move? Then we'll make you move!
ja: 動かないってのか? だったら動かせてやるよ!

key: ARCHER: Good job, \PN. Thanks to your diversion, we're in.
en: ARCHER: Good job, \PN. Thanks to your diversion, we're in.
ja: アーチャー: よくやった、\PN。お前の陽動のおかげで、入り込めたぞ。

key: DeFacto's with us too, so let's get this settled!
en: DeFacto's with us too, so let's get this settled!
ja: デファクトも一緒だ、片をつけるとしよう!

key: Yo, bro. You know where you are? You with the Magma Gang.
en: Yo, bro. You know where you are? You with the Magma Gang.
ja: よお、兄弟。ここがどこかわかってんのか? マグマ団の縄張りだぜ。

key: You know where you should be? Anywhere else. Get out.
en: You know where you should be? Anywhere else.  Get out.
ja: お前がいるべき場所、わかるか? ここ以外のどこかだ。出てけ。

key: Didn't I tell you to get? Look, only Magma Gang members are allowed in here. So you ain't gonna pass.
en: Didn't I tell you to get? Look, only Magma Gang members are allowed in here. So you ain't gonna pass.
ja: 消えろって言ったよな? いいか、ここに入れるのはマグマ団のメンバーだけだ。通さねえぞ。

key: That is... Unless you wanna join us. Whaddya say?
en: That is... Unless you wanna join us. Whaddya say?
ja: それとも……仲間に入りたいのか? どうする?

key: Hey... We got a bite. All right, so you know what's up. But we gotta see if you have what it takes.
en: Hey... We got a bite. All right, so you know what's up.  But we gotta see if you have what it takes.
ja: おい……食いついてきたな。よし、話は早い。だが、それだけの器があるか見せてもらうぜ。

key: On your mark! Get set! Go!
en: On your mark! Get set! Go!
ja: 位置について! 用意! ドン!

key: Then leave!
en: Then leave!
ja: だったら帰れ!

key: NIHIL: Just shoot me now.
en: NIHIL: Just shoot me now.
ja: ニヒル: いっそ撃ってくれ。

key: NIHIL: I'm left alone all night with Kriz while you guys do the fun stuff.
en: NIHIL: I'm left alone all night with Kriz while you guys do the fun stuff.
ja: ニヒル: お前らが面白いことしてる間、俺は一晩中クリズと二人きりだぜ。

key: Fuck my life.
en: Fuck my life.
ja: 人生詰んでる。

key: NIHIL: Oh, yes? Well, not bad, I suppose.
en: NIHIL: Oh, yes? Well, not bad, I suppose.
ja: ニヒル: へえ、そうかい。まあ、悪くないんじゃねえの。

key: You know where you should be? In a ditch, breathless. That's where all of Aqua Gang should be!
en: You know where you should be? In a ditch, breathless. That's where all of Aqua Gang should be!
ja: お前がいるべき場所、わかるか? 息絶えた溝の中だ。アクア団は全員そこに行くべきなんだよ!

key: You going? No? Cool, then I get to thrash ya.
en: You going? No? Cool, then I get to thrash ya.
ja: 行くのか? 行かない? いいね、それならぶちのめしてやるよ。

key: NIHIL: The hell was that?
en: NIHIL: The hell was that?
ja: ニヒル: 今のは何だよ?

key: MAXWELL: Hello, wanderer!
en: MAXWELL: Hello, wanderer!
ja: マクスウェル: よお、旅人!

key: Welcome, to the Magma Gang.
en: Welcome, to the Magma Gang.
ja: マグマ団へようこそ。

key: Impressive entry battle you had.
en: Impressive entry battle you had.
ja: 見事な入団試験だったな。

key: Allow me to introduce myself!
en: Allow me to introduce myself!
ja: 自己紹介させてもらおう!

key: I am Maxwell, leader of the Magma Gang!
en: I am Maxwell, leader of the Magma Gang!
ja: 俺はマクスウェル、マグマ団のリーダーだ!

key: You've already met Kriz and Nihil.
en: You've already met Kriz and Nihil.
ja: クリズとニヒルにはもう会ってるな。

key: The others are Darm and Break.
en: The others are Darm and Break.
ja: 他にはダームとブレークがいる。

key: Feel free to ignore anything Break says.
en: Feel free to ignore anything Break says.
ja: ブレークが何を言おうと、気にしなくていいぜ。

key: BREAK: Oh? How boring.
en: BREAK: Oh? How boring.
ja: ブレーク: へえ? つまんねえの。

key: MAXWELL: You, friend, are going to be a fantastic asset to us.
en: MAXWELL: You, friend, are going to be a fantastic asset to us.
ja: マクスウェル: お前は、俺たちにとってすごい戦力になるぜ。

key: See, I'm kind of like a gentleman thief.
en: See, I'm kind of like a gentleman thief.
ja: 俺はまあ、いわば紳士的な盗賊ってやつでな。

key: Steal from the greedy, give to the poor--
en: Steal from the greedy, give to the poor--
ja: 欲深い奴から奪って、貧しい者に与える――

key: That's us, by the way--
en: That's us, by the way--
ja: ちなみに、それが俺たちってわけだ――

key: Bring balance to the world...
en: Bring balance to the world...
ja: 世界に釣り合いをもたらす……

key: All that wonderful stuff.
en: All that wonderful stuff.
ja: そういう素晴らしいことをな。

key: Unfortunately, there's another group making that difficult:
en: Unfortunately, there's another group making that difficult:
ja: 残念ながら、それを難しくしてる別の組織がいてな。

key: The Aqua Gang.
en: The Aqua Gang.
ja: アクア団だ。

key: They're nothing more than greedy thieves.
en: They're nothing more than greedy thieves.
ja: あいつらは、ただの欲深い盗人にすぎねえ。

key: But!
en: But!
ja: だが!

key: With you around, we'll outnumber them, and finally claim our stake!
en: With you around, we'll outnumber them, and finally claim our stake!
ja: お前がいれば数で勝って、ついに俺たちの取り分を手にできるってわけだ!

key: We make our first move tonight.
en: We make our first move tonight.
ja: 今夜、俺たちは最初の一手を打つ。

key: Meet us at the empty shack in Lapis.
en: Meet us at the empty shack in Lapis.
ja: ラピスにある空き小屋で落ち合おう。

key: It's around 4th and Hydrangea.
en: It's around 4th and Hydrangea.
ja: 4番街とハイドランジア通りの辺りだ。

key: For glory, baby.
en: For glory, baby.
ja: 栄光のために、ベイビー。

key: MAXWELL: We make our first move tonight.
en: MAXWELL: We make our first move tonight.
ja: マクスウェル: 今夜、俺たちは最初の一手を打つ。

key: MAXWELL: Brilliant, baby.
en: MAXWELL: Brilliant, baby.
ja: マクスウェル: 見事だったぜ、ベイビー。

key: That's really gonna set the Aqua Gang in their place.
en: That's really gonna set the Aqua Gang in their place.
ja: あれで、アクア団にもいい思い知らせになっただろうよ。

key: You can keep the Pokémon you found.
en: You can keep the Pokémon you found.
ja: 見つけたポケモンは、お前が持ってていいぜ。

key: After all, it's not like we're the ones who use Water-types.
en: After all, it's not like we're the ones who use Water-types.
ja: どうせ俺たちは、みずタイプなんて使わねえからな。

key: We're gonna lay low for a bit and figure out where to go next.
en: We're gonna lay low for a bit and figure out where to go next.
ja: しばらく身を潜めて、次の一手を考えるとするさ。

key: But, you'd better come back around soon.
en: But, you'd better come back around soon.
ja: だが、またすぐ戻ってこいよ。

key: We'll need you.
en: We'll need you.
ja: お前が必要になるからな。

key: MAXWELL: \PN! Just the person we were looking for.
en: MAXWELL: \PN! Just the person we were looking for.
ja: マクスウェル: \PN! ちょうど探してた相手だ。

key: Listen up, we're gonna need you now more than ever.
en: Listen up, we're gonna need you now more than ever.
ja: よく聞け、今こそお前が必要なんだ。

key: We've got a mission, I think we're ready for it, but it isn't gonna be easy.
en: We've got a mission, I think we're ready for it, but it isn't gonna be easy.
ja: 任務がある、こっちの準備はできてると思うが、簡単じゃねえぞ。

key: You in?
en: You in?
ja: やるか?

key: Of course you are!
en: Of course you are!
ja: もちろんやるよな!

key: You're one of us, after all! Hahah!
en: You're one of us, after all! Hahah!
ja: だってお前は、俺たちの仲間だからな! はっはっ!

key: So here's the plan:
en: So here's the plan:
ja: それじゃ、作戦はこうだ。

key: We take over the Aqua Gang's HQ.
en: We take over the Aqua Gang's HQ.
ja: アクア団の本部を乗っ取る。

key: Storm it. Drive them out.
en: Storm it. Drive them out.
ja: 突入して、奴らを追い出す。

key: For good.
en: For good.
ja: 完全にな。

key: Meet us over there.
en: Meet us over there.
ja: あっちで落ち合おう。

key: We'll hit 'em where it hurts.
en: We'll hit 'em where it hurts.
ja: 奴らの痛いところを突いてやる。

key: It's gonna be grand, baby.
en: It's gonna be grand, baby.
ja: でかいことになるぜ、ベイビー。

key: MAXWELL: You guys are here, and with so few!
en: MAXWELL: You guys are here, and with so few!
ja: マクスウェル: 来やがったか、しかもこんな少人数で!

key: It's you, isn't it?
en: It's you, isn't it?
ja: お前だな?

key: You're their new ace.
en: You're their new ace.
ja: あいつらの新しいエースってわけか。

key: You're supposed to take me out, right?
en: You're supposed to take me out, right?
ja: 俺を仕留める役目ってわけだ、そうだろ?

key: So be it!
en: So be it!
ja: それなら受けて立つぜ!

key: But if I turn the tables on you, they've got nothing.
en: But if I turn the tables on you, they've got nothing.
ja: だが、俺がお前を返り討ちにすりゃ、あいつらには何も残らねえ。

key: The conflict between Aqua and Magma has been rehashed long enough!
en: The conflict between Aqua and Magma has been rehashed long enough!
ja: アクアとマグマの争いも、もう十分すぎるほど繰り返されてきた!

key: It's over now!
en: It's over now!
ja: もう終わりにする!

key: For glory, baby!
en: For glory, baby!
ja: 栄光のために、ベイビー!

key: Hah. After everything, it's come to this, huh?
en: Hah. After everything, it's come to this, huh?
ja: はっ。結局、こういうことになるのか。

key: MAXWELL: Ugh!
en: MAXWELL: Ugh!
ja: マクスウェル: うぐっ!

key: Magma Gang, we'll fall back!
en: Magma Gang, we'll fall back!
ja: マグマ団、退却するぞ!

key: For now...
en: For now...
ja: 今はな……

key: ARCHER: Finally.
en: ARCHER: Finally.
ja: アーチャー: ようやくか。

key: Magma's nonsense has been put to rest.
en: Magma's nonsense has been put to rest.
ja: マグマのくだらない騒ぎも、これで片づいた。

key: Great job, DeFacto.
en: Great job, DeFacto.
ja: よくやった、デファクト。

key: You too, \PN.
en: You too, \PN.
ja: お前もな、\PN。

key: We'll be heading back to our own territory now, hopefully unbothered by these crooks.
en: We'll be heading back to our own territory now, hopefully unbothered by these crooks.
ja: これで俺たちも自分たちの縄張りに戻れる、あの悪党どもに邪魔されずに済むといいがな。

key: Come see us soon.
en: Come see us soon.
ja: また近いうちに顔を見せてくれ。

key: MAXWELL: \PN, star of the show!
en: MAXWELL: \PN, star of the show!
ja: マクスウェル: \PN、今日の主役だな!

key: You wiped them out!
en: You wiped them out!
ja: 奴らを一掃しちまったな!

key: So lookie, I realised we never actually gave you a proper initiation when you joined.
en: So lookie, I realised we never actually gave you a proper initiation when you joined.
ja: それでよ、お前が入団したとき、ちゃんとした入団儀式をしてやってなかったなって気づいてさ。

key: It's a certain Pokémon.
en: It's a certain Pokémon.
ja: あるポケモンなんだが。

key: It's kind of the gang's thing.
en: It's kind of the gang's thing.
ja: 俺たちの団のシンボルみたいなもんでな。

key: Go on, take it!
en: Go on, take it!
ja: ほら、受け取れ!

key: You're one of us now, baby.
en: You're one of us now, baby.
ja: お前はもう俺たちの仲間だ、ベイビー。

key: For life!
en: For life!
ja: 一生な!

key: MAXWELL: Now what do we do, with no Aqua Gang...
en: MAXWELL: Now what do we do, with no Aqua Gang...
ja: マクスウェル: さて、アクア団もいなくなって、これからどうするかね……

key: No matter.
en: No matter.
ja: まあいいさ。

key: You ever need us for anything, \PN, you just give the say-so.
en: You ever need us for anything, \PN, you just give the say-so.
ja: 何か必要なことがあれば、\PN、いつでも声をかけてくれ。

key: We're family, and we got your back.
en: We're family, and we got your back.
ja: 俺たちは家族だ、お前の背後は任せとけ。

key: MAXWELL: You ever need us for anything, \PN, you just give the say-so.
en: MAXWELL: You ever need us for anything, \PN, you just give the say-so.
ja: マクスウェル: 何か必要なことがあれば、\PN、いつでも声をかけてくれ。

key: You want into 7th Street, huh?
en: You want into 7th Street, huh?
ja: 7番街に入りたいのか?

key: Cool.
en: Cool.
ja: いいぜ。

key: Heh, you won't find it lookin' around up here, that's for sure.
en: Heh, you won't find it lookin' around up here, that's for sure.
ja: へっ、この辺をいくら見て回ったって見つからねえよ、そりゃ確かだ。

key: See, there's a strange thing with the street numbers in Reborn.
en: See, there's a strange thing with the street numbers in Reborn.
ja: 実はな、リボーンの通りの番号には、ちょっと変なところがあるんだ。

key: In Peridot, you've got 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. Then Opal Bridge is 5th and 6th...
en: In Peridot, you've got 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. Then Opal Bridge is 5th and 6th...
ja: ペリドットには1番街、2番街、3番街、4番街がある。それでオパール大橋が5番街と6番街で……

key: But in the Obsidia Ward, the next one is 8th Street.
en: But in the Obsidia Ward, the next one is 8th Street.
ja: だが、オブシディア区に入ると、次は8番街になる。

key: And that's just it.
en: And that's just it.
ja: それだけの話だ。

key: 7th Street ain't no ordinary avenue.
en: 7th Street ain't no ordinary avenue.
ja: 7番街ってのは、ただの通りじゃねえのさ。

key: 7th Street is Reborn's very own black market.
en: 7th Street is Reborn's very own black market.
ja: 7番街は、リボーン独自の闇市場ってわけだ。

key: Civilians and city officials don't even know about it; it's completely solid.
en: Civilians and city officials don't even know about it; it's completely solid.
ja: 一般市民も市の役人も、その存在すら知らない。完全に隠されてるんだ。

key: So we can totally hook you up.
en: So we can totally hook you up.
ja: だから、俺たちなら手引きしてやれるってわけさ。

key: We've got a place in Lapis, bit south of 4th and Hydrangea.
en: We've got a place in Lapis, bit south of 4th and Hydrangea.
ja: ラピスに拠点があるんだ、4番街とハイドランジア通りの少し南だ。

key: Check it out, and you'll be in, no problem.
en: Check it out, and you'll be in, no problem.
ja: 顔を出しゃ、すんなり仲間になれるさ。

key: Go on and chase your glory, baby.
en: Go on and chase your glory, baby.
ja: さあ、栄光を追いかけな、ベイビー。

key: MAXWELL: We can totally hook you up.
en: MAXWELL: We can totally hook you up.
ja: マクスウェル: 俺たちなら、しっかり手引きしてやれるぜ。

key: BREAK: You've got something on your face.
en: BREAK: You've got something on your face.
ja: ブレーク: 顔に何かついてるぜ。

key: BREAK: Nope, still there.
en: BREAK: Nope, still there.
ja: ブレーク: いや、まだついてる。

key: BREAK: Don't ignore me, man! I'm tellin' you, if you do, the Caterpolice will arrest your mind!
en: BREAK: Don't ignore me, man! I'm tellin' you, if you do, the Caterpolice will arrest your mind!
ja: ブレーク: 無視すんなよ! いいか、無視したら「毛虫警察」がお前の心を逮捕しにくるぞ!

key: BREAK: Easy as cake~ A chocolate cake! With strawberry icing.
en: BREAK: Easy as cake~ A chocolate cake! With strawberry icing.
ja: ブレーク: ケーキよりも簡単さ~ チョコレートケーキ! いちごのアイシング付きでね。

key: Strawberry on chocolate- or actually any fruit on chocolate- is deceptively delicious.
en: Strawberry on chocolate- or actually any fruit on chocolate- is deceptively delicious.
ja: チョコにいちご――というか、チョコに果物ってのは、見た目以上においしいもんなんだよ。

key: Most people assume that the chocolate of a chocolate cake should be in the frosting, but that is absolutely not true!
en: Most people assume that the chocolate of a chocolate cake should be in the frosting, but that is absolutely not true!
ja: 大抵の人は、チョコレートケーキのチョコはフロスティングにあるものだと思ってるけど、それは絶対に違うんだ!

key: To put the essence of something only in its outer layer- why, it's just like sweeping it under the rug.
en: To put the essence of something only in its outer layer- why, it's just like sweeping it under the rug.
ja: 何かの本質を、外側の層にだけ詰め込むなんて――そんなの、じゅうたんの下に掃いて隠すようなもんじゃないか。

key: And we are hardly anxious to return to the strictness of Victorian culture... Oh yes, that's right.
en: And we are hardly anxious to return to the strictness of Victorian culture... Oh yes, that's right.
ja: それに、ヴィクトリア朝の堅苦しい文化に戻りたいなんて誰も思っちゃいないだろ……ああ、そうそう。

key: The Victorian era was just like a chocolate-frosted cake... Don't you see?
en: The Victorian era was just like a chocolate-frosted cake... Don't you see?
ja: ヴィクトリア朝時代は、まさにチョコがけのケーキみたいなものだったのさ……わかるだろ?

key: DARM: Sup, fresh meat. Name's Darm.
en: DARM: Sup, fresh meat. Name's Darm.
ja: ダーム: よお、新入り。名前はダームだ。

key: Short for Darmanitan. The Pokémon? You know why they just call me Darm though?
en: Short for Darmanitan. The Pokémon? You know why they just call me Darm though?
